description: This file defines an abstract base class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef' used for validating and cleaning HTML attribute definitions, as well as other string validation tasks related to HTML, CSS, and similar data. It includes methods for validation, parsing CDATA, factory creation, and internal utilities.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef
classes.description: Abstract base class providing validation, cleaning, and utility methods for HTML attribute definitions and other string validation tasks.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Abstract method intended to validate and clean a string based on the attribute's definition, requiring implementation in subclasses.

methods.name: parseCDATA
methods.description: Converts a string into a form suitable for CDATA by trimming whitespace, normalizing line feeds, tabs, and carriage returns.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Factory method that creates or returns an instance of the class based on a string identifier, defaulting to returning the current object.

methods.name: mungeRgb
methods.description: Internal utility method to remove spaces in rgb() CSS color functions to support shorthand properties.
